description: Revision of the exhaustive zebra-grid solver. Fixes the defect that made every firing item crash with 'too many values to unpack (expected 3)': _classify stored value matches as dicts {s,e,ci,vi} but unpacked them as 3-tuples in the gap/adjacent/left/right/equality/house branches, so before_call always fell into the exception handler and returned no note. All branches now read the dict fields directly. Retains the earlier fixes: true text-span value matching with longest-match suppression ('tall' no longer fires inside 'very tall'), hyphenated multi-word values like 'ford f150' resolving to th
header: Exhaustive zebra-grid solver: unique verified solution table or no note.
